environment.description: Staging Kubernetes cluster running identical stream processor binary. LaunchDarkly project 'event-platform-staging' has the flag 'enable-enriched-event-processing' configured with a targeting rule that evaluates context kind='service' with attribute matching against an allowlist. The flag's fallthrough variation is set to index 1 (false). The specific targeting rule requires the context key to match 'stream-processor-canary' (not 'stream-processor'). The off variation is index 1 (false). Flag prerequisites include 'enrichment-service-healthy' which is currently evaluating to false in staging due to the enrichment service being decommissioned from the staging environment on 2024-02-01. The SDK is initialized with the staging SDK key and the relay proxy endpoint at ldrelay.internal:8030 which serves cached flag state with a 30-second polling interval.
